# AppPage — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A full-viewport page scaffold composed of six sub-components: `AppPage` (root), `AppPageHeader` (top bar), `AppPageMain` (fill area), `AppPageAside` (sidebar), `AppPageContent` (content area), and `AppPageFooter` (pinned footer). `AppPageFooter` can be placed as a direct child of `AppPage` to span the full width, or passed via `AppPageContent`'s `footer` prop to pin it inside the content column only.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below. Use the HTML Skill lookup command with `--id extensions.app-page --read-source` to read the source closure. Copy the templates into `src/components/cobalt-extensions/`, then import using a relative path to that project-local directory and adapt the implementation there.

Workspace creation copies the full tree. For a standalone/existing app, run the bundled `cobalt-project.mjs copy-source --out <project>`; it copies source without installing dependencies or replacing existing files. Read the copied `dependencies.json` and add only the required official dependencies to the target app.
